dct_description_sm: The objective of this study was to assess numerous performance measures of turfgrass (L-93 Creeping bentgrass maintained at golf course fairway height) treated with the following products: CTD Ready-2-Mix (Suncor), Experimental CC (Suncor), Insignia SC, Heritage Action, Signature Xtra Stressgard, Water control treatment, Drought control treatment. Treatments were evaluated under both well-watered (no-stress) and drought stress conditions.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Drought comparison greenhouse study: Fairway height L-93 creeping bentgrass
